Pianooo is here to make your musical journey a little more enjoyable, one note at a time. It's free and made by one musician. Here's how you can help it grow.
Pianooo measures how late your sound out: Pianooo measures how late your sound output plays and lights keys, counts in and reads taps to match. If it still feels off — Bluetooth headphones, or General MIDI played through an external instrument — shift it here. This moves the picture, not the sound: no setting can make a note arrive sooner.
Pianooo shares the sound card with every: Pianooo shares the sound card with everything else, so you still hear YouTube, video calls and other apps alongside it. Windows adds its usual delay between key and sound.
Pianooo supports MIDI, Karaoke, MusicXML: Pianooo supports MIDI, Karaoke, MusicXML, Guitar Pro, and Capella file formats.
Pianooo takes over the whole sound card:: Pianooo takes over the whole sound card: other apps stay silent while Pianooo is open.
Pianooo talks to your sound card directl: Pianooo talks to your sound card directly, past Windows' mixer: the shortest delay from key to sound. Recommended when the delay between pressing a key and hearing it feels uncomfortable.
